newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, April 15 - Santa Fe - No vessels berthed, no vessels in roads. Max. draft 21 ft. 5 in. at access channel. Diamante - No vessels berthed, no vessels in roads. Max. draft 21 ft. 7 in. at passage KM 520. San Lorenzo - Eight vessels berthed of which 1 loading by-products, 1 loading sbmp, 3 loading maize, 2 loading sun oil, 1 loading sbm. 3 Vessels in roads, 16 due at six terminals in the coming week. Max. draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. The forecast indicates that the draft will fall about 0.15 metres during next week.

Rosario - Seven vessels berthed of which 1 awaiting orders, 3 loading maize, 1 discharging fertiliser, 1 loading soya, 1 loading sbo, 6 vessels in roads, 18 due during the coming week. Max. draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. The forecast indicates that the draft will fall about 0.15 metres during next week. Villa Constitucion - No vessels berthed, none in roads, 1 due. Elevator berths max. draft 22 ft. 0 in. Fw. Max. draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel.

San Nicolas - Three vessels berthed of which 1 discharging coal, 1 loading soya, 1 loading maize. 1 Vessel in roads, 4 due during the week. Max. draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. The forecast indicates that the draft will fall about 0.20 metres during next week. San Pedro - No vessels berthed, none in roads, 2 due. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. The forecast indicates that the draft will fall about 0.20 metres during next week. Max. draft for Mitre channel 32 ft.,33 ft. Fw at high tide.

Buenos Aires - 15 Vessels in port, 25 due during the week. Max. draft 31 ft. 6 in. high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Dock and sud max draft 28,29 ft. Fw high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Necochea - One vessel loading wheat, 3 in roads, 12 due. Max. draft at entrance channel 40 ft. 0 in. Bw. Bahia Blanca - Eight vessels berthed of which 1 awaiting orders, 1 loading maize, 1 loading wheat, 1 loading crude, 1 loading fertiliser, 2 loading fish. 1 Vessel in roads, 13 due during the week. Draft depends on each berth.

BRAZIL, April 15 - Vitoria - Vessels berthed, 1 general cargo/container discharger/loader, 1 pig iron loader, 1 granite loader, 1 steel wire loader, 1 vehicles discharger, 1 wheat discharger. Tubarao - 3 Iron ore loaders. Praia Mole - 3 Steel products loaders, 1 coal discharger. Ubu - 1 Iron ore loader, 22 vessels waiting in roads. Santos - Casual port workers came out on a general strike from 0700 hrs. 15/4, for an indefinite period of time. Vessels berthed, 1 bulk gasoil discharger, 1 full container loader/discharger, 1 bulk cement, 1 container discharger, 6 general cargo/container loader/discharger, 1 general cargo loader, 1 bulk soya loader, 1 container loader, 1 bulk pellets loader, 2 fertiliser dischargers. 17 Vessels waiting in roads, 81 due during next 7 days.

Private terminals - Cosipa - 1 Bulk coal discharger, 1 iron ore discharger. Ultrafertil - 1 Bulk sulphur discharger. Paranagua - Vessels berthed - 2 Fertiliser dischargers, 4 pellets loaders, 3 general cargo loaders. 29 Vessels waiting in roads of which 13 pellets loaders, 1 general cargo, 12 soya, 2 fertiliser, 1 container vessel for discharging. 23 Vessels due during next 7 days. Rio Grande - Vessels berthed, 3 full container loaders, 1 wheat loader, 2 expellers loaders. 6 Vessels waiting in roads, 18 due during next 10 days.

Rio de Janeiro - Vessels berthed, 1 general cargo/container discharger, 1 general cargo discharger, 1 wheat discharger, 1 paper discharger, 1 research vessel, 1 oil discharger, 3 steel products discharger, 1 caustic soda discharger, 1 passenger vessel. Tecon - 2 Vessels, 29 due during next 7 days. Sao Sebastiao - Tebar - 1 Vessel berthed. Commercial quay - 1 Vessel berthed. Three vessels waiting in roads, 2 due during next 7 days.

CHILE, April 14 - Arica - One vessel in terminal, 5 berths vacant, 9 vessels due during week. Iquique - Four vessels berthed working normally, 3 berths vacant, 6 vessels due during week. Antofagasta - Two vessels berthed, 5 berths available, 13 vessels due during week for loading and discharging concentrates, bulk copper, containers and general cargo. Valparaiso - Seven vessels berthed working normally. 1 Berth vacant, 1 berth out of service due to enlargement of pier 13. 14 Vessels due during week, 1 days delay can be expected. San Antonio - Five vessels operating, 5 berths vacant, 15 vessels due during week. Port busy but no waiting time.

Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - No vessels berthed, 3 due, no vessels waiting in roads. San Vicente - Two vessels berthed working normally, 1 berth vacant, 6 vessels due during week, 1 days berthing delay expected. Steel pier - 1 Vessel berthed. No vessels due. Coronel pier - 1 Vessel berthed. Oil terminal - No vessels, 1 due during week. Navy pier (Molo 500) - 2 Vessels berthed. None due. Lirquen - One vessel berthed, 3 berths vacant, 3 due. Penco - No vessels. Puerto Montt - Two vessels in port, 1 passenger, 5 due during week. Punta Arenas - Three fishing vessels berthed, 7 vessels due during week.

PERU, April 14 - Callao - Seven vessels in bay, 4 in pier (general cargo,containers), no berthing delays. Paita - Two days berthing delays. Bayovar, Pisco - No vessels. Talara - One vessel in bay, 1 in pier (oil), no berthing delays. Chimbote - One fishmeal vessel in bay, no berthing delays. Ilo - Three fishmeal vessels in pier, no berthing delays.

VENEZUELA, April 14 - Puerto Cabello - Three vessels anchored, 14 berthed of which 6 grain, 5 general cargo, 3 containers. Piers 1 and 2 closed. Guanta - Four vessels anchored, 1 general cargo vessel berthed.
